means: Visible shafts of light crossing open air, as though the beam itself were an object you could walk into - sun through a high window, through cloud, through a forest canopy.
does: Turns empty space into a graphic element: diagonal bright wedges that give an otherwise dead background something to compose with. The catch is that the model has no concept of light scattering in air; it draws shafts only when it can infer a source and something for the light to catch on. The phrasing that works names the THING - sunbeam, light shafts through a window, and above all dust motes floating in the light, which is what makes the shaft read as an object rather than a bright patch on the floor. Bare god rays is the weakest of the three spellings. The measured sweep puts subtle and dusty only 28.97 apart on a card classed RECOMPOSED, so do not expect the intensity grades to separate.
reach_for_it: when an interior needs depth and age - a shut-up room, a cathedral, a warehouse - or when you want the light source itself to be a character in the frame
used_in: studio/cards/light_god_rays.json (five grades); studio/lighting/sunbeam.json, whose note records that the dust motes are the tag doing the work
